## Summary

peiker acustic traces back to Beerwald and Co., founded in Bad Homburg
in 1946 by Paul Beerwald and Heinrich Peiker; the business moved to
Friedrichsdorf in 1992 [1]. In 2015 the owning family sold most of
peiker acustic to the French supplier Valeo, keeping the microphone and
loudspeaker business and PEI TEL Communications [1], and Valeo lists
peiker acustic among its 2015 acquisitions [2]. The company made
hands-free telephone systems, telematics, navigation and music systems
and eCall modules, and supplied infotainment and telephone systems to
Mercedes-Benz and BMW [1].

The IEEE registry lists two MA-L blocks and one IAB block to "peiker
acustic GmbH" at Max-Planck-Strasse 28-32, Friedrichsdorf [3][4]; the
MA-M block registered to "peiker CEE" in Bad Homburg is a separate
registrant and not aliased here [5]. A MAC from these blocks is most
plausibly an in-car telephone or telematics unit in a German premium
vehicle, but no source ties a block to a product, and the radios are
not documented [1]. An NVD keyword search for peiker returned no CVEs
[6]. The FCC ID databases refused the session that wrote this entry, so
no grantee code or silicon is listed.
